brief.zh: 标出主干，把修饰成分折起来。
brief.en: Mark the skeleton, folding the modifiers away.

t.zh: 关系词省掉了，介词又被留在了从句的末尾。
t.en: The relative word is left out, and a preposition is left behind at the clause’s end.

hint.zh: data 后面直接跟着 the model was trained on：模型是在什么上训练的？
hint.en: data is followed straight away by the model was trained on: trained on what?

hint.zh: 这句话里有两个谓语样子的动词，主干的是哪一个？
hint.en: Two verbs look like the main one: which belongs to the skeleton?

sentence: The data the model was trained on came from three hospitals.

was trained.zh: was trained 在从句里：(that) the model was trained on 说明是哪些数据，即模型训练所用的数据。主干的谓语是后面的动词。
was trained.en: was trained is inside the clause: (that) the model was trained on says which data, the data the model was trained on. The skeleton’s verb comes later.

the model.zh: the model 是从句的主语。从三家医院来的不是模型，是数据。
the model.en: the model is the clause’s subject. What came from three hospitals is not the model but the data.

title.zh: The data the model was trained on came from three hospitals.
title.en: The data the model was trained on came from three hospitals.

body.zh: The data (that) the model was trained on：省掉了 that，on 留在末尾，等于 the data on which the model was trained。主干 The data came：模型的训练数据来自三家医院。
body.en: The data (that) the model was trained on: that is left out and on stays at the end, as in the data on which the model was trained. The skeleton is The data came: the training data came from three hospitals.

note.zh: 名词后面紧跟一整句、末尾还挂着介词：多半是省了关系词的定语从句。
note.en: A noun followed by a whole clause ending in a preposition: mostly a relative clause without its relative word.
